title: GPSPingTelemetry
description: Standard schema for raw mobility GPS pings ingested into GeoPulse pipeline

ping_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the telemetry ping

device_id.description: Anonymized persistent identifier for the mobile device

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the recorded ping

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate in decimal degrees

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate in decimal degrees

altitude_meters.description: Estimated altitude above sea level in meters

horizontal_accuracy_meters.description: 68% confidence circle radius in meters (GPS CEP)

speed_mps.description: Instantaneous ground speed in meters per second

heading_degrees.description: Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north
